  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  June 12, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on June 12, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, City Clerk’s Department
  Sy’Naelyn Thomas, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on May 22, 2025.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Otto Benedict on behalf of Live Nation at SoFi to host a Post Malone – The Big Ass Stadium
  Tour Event at 1001 Stadium Dr. – SoFi Stadium, Private Property; on Thursday, June
  19,2025, APPROVED CONDITIONALLY: Approval for 1 day event within Sofi Stadium.
  Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable mitigation
  measures; Applicant to film exclusively interior, on private property and only at the locations
  listed on the application. No exterior filming is permitted off SoFi property, including any use
  of public streets, sidewalks or alleys. Special effects or pyrotechnics are not authorized
  unless written approval is obtained from both SoFi Stadium Management and the Los
  Angeles County Fire Department. Police Staffing TBD by the Inglewood P.D. ,Special Events
  Unit; Code Enforcement staff to be deployed to address unpermitted vending (20+/- staff
  members); No Fire recommendations; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00405797)

Item #3:  Daniel Medina on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host a Movies in the Park Event at 700
  Warren Lane; Public Property; on Sunday, June 28, 2025, from 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY: Approval for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject
  to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park; Applicant to provide adequate parks &
  recreation staff for the servicing of park facilities / restrooms that is expected to be utilized by
  attendees during this event. IPD recommends that a minimum of two (2) police officers and
  two (2) city hall security officers be deployed at this event for overall public safety. *Security
  officers should monitor the restroom area being utilized by attendees to deter any outside
  lewd conduct activity and assist IPD with any potential crowd control. IPD watch commander
  will be notified and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time permits; No additional
  recommendations for Fire approval; No code enforcement conditions; Maintain site at all
  times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405858)

New Business License Request (s):

Item #6:  Olga Zilberman DBA 5 Star Doggy Inn to operate as a Kennel at 519 S. Hindry Ave.;
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Approval for a boarding kennel for cats
  and dogs; Applicant shall provide current applicable state licensing, valid identification
  (including current residential addresses) on ALL employees. Applicant shall maintain a clean
  / sanitized facility at all times to ensure the health & safety of all animals being serviced or
  housed at the establishment. This facility is subject to inspection by any Inglewood Police
  Officer(s), Code Enforcement Officer(s) or Animal Control Officer(s) at anytime of the day or
  night. NO improper disposal of waste products of anykind. In the interest of public & animal
  safety, This establishment shall NOT employ or have anyone in the business that may
  potentially pose a safety risk to employees, customers or animals (ie; any persons with prior
  violent crime convictions or any crimes against animals). Adhere to all local, state and federal
  laws..Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of
  your business license and any future business license application requests. (Activity
  No. 00405591)

Item #7:  24Seven Group Inc DBA 24Seven Rent A Car to operate as a Auto Rent/Lease at 4761 W.
  Century Blvd.; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Conditional Approval for
  a car rental business. Conditions: must complete Site Plan Review for parking lot site
  improvements and tenant improvements. Must complete Building Safety plan check;
  Applicant shall provide valid ID on him/herself and all employees (including any state DMV
  licenses if applicable). Applicant to have all vehicles registered, possess and have on display,
 Permits & License Committee  June 12, 2025
Minutes  Page 4 of 5

  a State of California dealer's license and any applicable permits / licenses issued by the
  California DMV. NO parking of any vehicles, vehicle repairs / maintenance on any city streets,
  sidewalks or alleys. NOTE: Car Rental businesses / establishments shall make every
  reasonable effort to properly ID all customers to avoid the likelihood of unwanted fraud or
  identity theft by persons with intentions of obtaining rental vehicles illegally or for nefarious
  purposes. Applicant is subject to random inspections by any city code enforcement officer or
  any peace officer (IPD or DMV Investigators) at anytime to ensure compliance of the
  conditions set forth by the City of Inglewood (Permits & Licenses Committee). Adhere to all
  local, state and federal laws; Code Enforcement Conditons: Must obtain planning approval
  for the unpermitted construction and building permits must be finalized before renewal of
  their business license/tax certificate Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned
  will result in the revocation of your business license and any future business license
  application requests. (Activity No. 00405906)

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):

Item #9:  Bani Market to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 591 S. LA Brea Ave. This Business
  License has been APPROVED with the following condition set forth by the Permits
  and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC),
  specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN
  THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all State and Federal Rules and
  Regulations; Retail area not exceed 12 Square Feet of total retail floor areaSales or
  display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored
  Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes;
  Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless Tobacco Products,
  Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco
  rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly Prohibited;Sales of
  tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly
 Permits & License Committee  June 12, 2025
Minutes  Page 5 of 5

  prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have a valid
  government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display of any type
  of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees
  are subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the
  day or night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections
  is to enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated
  cannabis products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic
  paraphernalia per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics,
  this would also include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to
  smoke / ingest illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and
  employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police
  related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or
  response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance,
  Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.);Applicant and employees are expected to be active
  participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that
  may necessitate a police response or response from other city government services (i.e.
  Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); andThe following
  is not allowed inside the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee
  review and permit: PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND,
  MUSIC BOXES (juke box), NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S)
  PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC. APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE
  BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR NIGHT) OF OPERATION.
